import { defineTable, col, rel } from "@rebasepro/server/schema";
import { areaType } from "./area_type";
import { areaTag } from "./area_tag";
import { areaTagRaw } from "./area_tag_raw";
import { artist } from "./artist";
import { editor } from "./editor";

// ⚠ Not reproduced exactly by `rebase db push` — read before pushing:
//   - "name" is a varchar with no length, declared as text: a push would convert it to text, which keeps every value.
export const area = defineTable("area", {
    columns: {
        id: col.serial().primaryKey(),
        gid: col.uuid().notNull(),
        name: col.text().notNull(),
        type: col.integer(),
        editsPending: col.integer().notNull().default(0).validate({ min: 0 }),
        lastUpdated: col.timestamptz().onCreateNow(),
        beginDateYear: col.smallint(),
        beginDateMonth: col.smallint(),
        beginDateDay: col.smallint(),
        endDateYear: col.smallint(),
        endDateMonth: col.smallint(),
        endDateDay: col.smallint(),
        ended: col.boolean().notNull().default(false),
        comment: col.varchar().notNull().default("")
    },
    relations: {
        typeRelation: rel.belongsTo(() => areaType, { localKey: "type", onDelete: "no action" }),
        area_tag: rel.hasMany(() => areaTag, { foreignKey: "area" }),
        area_tag_raw: rel.hasMany(() => areaTagRaw, { foreignKey: "area" }),
        artist: rel.hasMany(() => artist, { foreignKey: "area" }),
        artist_by_begin_area: rel.hasMany(() => artist, { foreignKey: "begin_area" }),
        artist_by_end_area: rel.hasMany(() => artist, { foreignKey: "end_area" }),
        editor: rel.hasMany(() => editor, { foreignKey: "area" })
    },
    rls: "admin-only"
});
